note: Closed supplement of model-identity.cjs. A model spelling that launch records use but that no registry list names. Identity only: it asserts that the spelling is one model, never which model a client served. Everything else comes from model-aliases.json (routeAliases, idEquivalents, makerRules) and from clients.json launchAliases; this file adds nothing a registry already says. exactIds names whole the launch spellings that fall outside the closed spelling grammar (upper case): an exact, case-sensitive equality with no folding; a key inside the grammar belongs to the registry lists and is refused here.
